news_items.headline: Southern Copper (SCCO) Valuation Check After Earnings Beats And Cuajone Mine Expansion Plan
news_items.summary: Valuation review following continued earnings beats and a new $318.6M upgrade plan for the Cuajone mine in Peru; flags stretched valuation against fundamentals.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus 'Sell' across 17 analysts (S&P Global), avg PT $158.91, ~11% below current price. Bank of America downgraded SCCO to Underperform from Neutral, raising PT to $175 from $162.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 results beat on EPS and revenue with strong YoY net income/operating cash flow growth (already priced in). Tailwinds: Tia Maria exploitation permit reinstated in Peru, copper near record highs on supply disruptions, new CEO and higher dividends. Sources gave conflicting near-term earnings-call dates (May 5 / May 18 references); next quarterly report not reliably confirmed, likely late July 2026.
